newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Trucks says order intake rises 15 pct Jan/Fe.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Trucks says order intake rises 15 pct Jan/Fe.

text.p: Volvo Trucks said on Monday that its order intake rose 15 percent in January/February 1997.
"In North America order intake is significantly higher than during the same period last year and in Europe order intake was higher," Volvo Trucks spokesman Stefan Lorentzson told Reuters.
The 27 percent fall in the unit's European deliveries in the first two months of 1997 to 4,830 trucks is not dramatic, he said.
"The entire market decreased because of strikes in Spain and France," Lorentzson said. "We strengthened our market share from 16.5 percent to 17 percent."
"In Europe, we make money ... and in the U.S. we take market shares -- 1997 has started better than last year."
Lorentzson added that nothing new had emerged about the unit's intention to get established in China, with one of five authorities having approved the request.
